from build123d import *
import math

def build(params):
    L = params["length"]; W = params["width"]; H = params["height"]
    t = params["wall"]; fl = params["floor"]; d = math.radians(params["draft_deg"])
    tn = math.tan(d)
    # wall measured normal to the drafted face
    tw = t / math.cos(d)
    s = H * tn  # outer inset at bottom per side
    outer = loft([
        Pos(0, 0, 0) * Rectangle(L - 2 * s, W - 2 * s),
        Pos(0, 0, H) * Rectangle(L, W),
    ])
    over = 1.0
    zb = fl
    zt = H + over
    il_top = L - 2 * tw + 2 * over * tn
    iw_top = W - 2 * tw + 2 * over * tn
    drop = (zt - zb) * tn
    pocket = loft([
        Pos(0, 0, zb) * Rectangle(il_top - 2 * drop, iw_top - 2 * drop),
        Pos(0, 0, zt) * Rectangle(il_top, iw_top),
    ])
    box = outer - pocket
    return {
        "parts": {"box": box},
        "features": [
            {"tag": "box", "part": "box", "tools": [outer]},
            {"tag": "pocket", "part": "box", "tools": [pocket]},
        ],
        "materials": {"box": "molded ABS"},
    }
